headline: Damage calc is in, plus a big pass on item effects.
notes: New damage calc behind Simulate in the Defense panel. Incoming shows what a hit really does to you after DEF, resists, Guard, Armor, glances and parries. Outgoing runs your attacks and skills against a target.
Skills from your gear show up as cards in the armory and under From equipment on the Skills sheet. The ones that buff you have a switch.
Tetra items have a crystal picker, Little Cheese has a switch, and Oni Heritage adds onto Sanguine Crest.
Added the 10 unarmored torsos that were missing, like Shadow Gi and Dragon Gi. Caster's Cape, Farmer's Shirt and Healer's Shroud boost your class stats.
Item switches are saved now. Before this they reset on refresh and never made it into saves or share links.
Fixed a bunch of items giving stats they shouldn't, like Creeping Darkness's free 25 Armor and the gauntlet shields stacking forever.
